name: AI response evaluation and rating (category)
summary: Remote gig work rating, ranking and rewriting chatbot or search outputs so AI companies can improve their models.
what_you_do: Typical tasks include reading two AI answers and choosing which better follows instructions, rewriting a weak answer, or rating search and content results against long guidelines. Work comes in project batches through platforms or vendors and is paid per hour or per task.
who_it_may_fit: You read carefully, write well, and want flexible remote side income you can scale up or down.
Fully remote with flexible hours on most platforms
Several platforms and vendors recruit Canada residents specifically
Strong writers and subject experts can earn well above minimum wage on some projects
Low barrier to try: most platforms are free to join
who_it_may_not_fit: You need stable hours, benefits, or a predictable paycheque.
Journalism describes the work as often underpaid, sporadic and precarious, with no benefits
Hours are rarely guaranteed and projects can end without notice
Screening tests and onboarding are often unpaid
Fake job offers imitate real platforms; legitimate ones do not charge you to join
Pay is usually quoted in US dollars and you are typically an independent contractor

conditions_notes: Globe and Mail (2023) interviews describe sporadic, per-task work; 2026 blogs describe project cuts and empty queues.
Platforms typically require guideline study and qualification tests.
